blocks.prompt: 10 (a) In how many ways can a set of 4 different blue pens, 3 different red pens and 6 black pens be placed in a rectangular form rack with a space for 10 pens if: All the pens are placed without any restriction.
blocks.explanation:
Alag alag pens rack ki jagahon mein rakhne hain; kaun sa pen kahan hai, is se arrangement badalti hai, yani order ahem hai.
Pens kul \(4 + 3 + 6 = 13\) hain, lekin kitab mein rack ki 10 jagahein likhi hain; neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhiye. Answer key ki tarah hum 13 jagahein aur sab pens alag maante hain.
Plan: koi shart nahi, to saare 13 pens: \(13!\).
Socho dukaan mein ek rack hai jis mein pens khare kar ke rakhe jate hain. Har pen alag hai (alag rang ya alag design), is liye jagah badalne se nayi tarteeb banti hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 4 neele, 3 laal, 6 kaale pens, sab alag maane gaye; rack mein 13 jagahein (ghalti ki durusti ke mutabiq).
Humein find karna hai: bina shart ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: \(n\) alag cheezein \(n\) jagahon par \(n!\) tareeqon se.
Kyun: Kaale pens ke liye "different" nahi likha, lekin answer key unhein bhi alag maanti hai, is liye hum bhi alag maante hain. Agar kaale pens bilkul ek jaise hote to jawab \(\frac{13!}{6!}\) hota, jo agla mauzu (objects not all different) hai.

Pens ginein
\[4 + 3 + 6 = 13\]
Kyun: Sawal kehta hai saare pens rakhne hain, is liye 13 jagahein chahiye. Yahin pata chalta hai ke 10 jagahon wali baat theek nahi baithti.

Tarteeb dein
\[13! = 6227020800\]
Kyun: 13 alag pens, 13 jagahein. \(13!\) humne Sawal 5(i) mein nikala tha.
Dhyan dein: \(13!\) bohat bara number hai; isay dobara shuru se multiply karne ki bajaye pehle wale sawal se uthana samajhdari hai.

Tasdeeq
Box method: 13 jagahon ke liye 13, 12, 11, ..., 1 choices; product \(13!\) \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Har pen ek hi dafa istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "a space for 10 pens" chhapa hai, lekin pens \(4 + 3 + 6 = 13\) hain; 10 jagahon mein saare pens aa hi nahi sakte, aur parts (b) aur (c) mein har pen rack par hona zaroori hai. Answer key (\(13!\), 622,080 aur 239,500,800) rack ko 13 jagahon wala aur saare 13 pens ko alag maanti hai, yani sahi alfaaz "a space for 13 pens" hain; yahan hal isi tarah kiya gaya hai. Agar waqai sirf 10 jagahein hon aur 13 mein se koi bhi 10 pens bina shart rakhe jayein, to part (a) ka jawab \({}^{13}P_{10} = 1{,}037{,}836{,}800\) hota (Sawal 5(iii)).

blocks.prompt: 10 (b) In how many ways can a set of 4 different blue pens, 3 different red pens and 6 black pens be placed in a rectangular form rack with a space for 10 pens if: All the pens of the same colour are placed together.
blocks.explanation:
Har rang ke pens ikatthe rehne chahiye, to har rang ek block (gathri) ban jata hai.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: pehle 3 blocks ki tarteeb, phir har block ke andar pens ki tarteeb, aur sab ko multiply.
Socho dukaandaar chahta hai ke rack saaf suthra lage: saare neele ek jagah, saare laal ek jagah, saare kaale ek jagah. Yahi "same colour together" hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 4 neele, 3 laal, 6 kaale pens (sab alag), 13 jagahein; ek rang ke pens ek saath.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Block method: blocks ki tarteeb \(\times\) har block ke andar ki tarteeb.
Kyun: Block method ka faida yeh hai ke "ikatthe" wali shart khud ba khud poori ho jati hai: jo cheezein baandh di gayin woh alag ho hi nahi saktin.

3 blocks ki tarteeb
\[3! = 6\]
Kyun: Neela, laal aur kaala block kisi bhi order mein aa sakte hain: neela-laal-kaala, kaala-neela-laal waghera. 3 cheezon ki tarteeb \(3!\).

Har block ke andar tarteeb
\[\text{Neela: } 4! = 24\]
\[\text{Laal: } 3! = 6\]
\[\text{Kaala: } 6! = 720\]
Kyun: Block ke andar us rang ke pens aapas mein jagah badal sakte hain, aur yeh alag arrangement hai kyunke pens alag hain.

Multiply karein
\[3! \times 4! \times 3! \times 6!\]
\[= 6 \times 24 \times 6 \times 720\]
\[= 864 \times 720 = 622080\]
Kyun: Blocks ki har tarteeb andar ki har tarteeb ke saath ban sakti hai (fundamental principle of counting). \(6 \times 24 = 144\), \(144 \times 6 = 864\).
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(4! \times 3! \times 6!\) likh kar blocks ka \(3!\) bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[864 \times 720 = 864 \times 700 + 864 \times 20\]
\[= 604800 + 17280 = 622080 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 720 ko 700 aur 20 mein tor kar multiply karna aasaan hai aur ghalti pakar leta hai.
Dhyan dein: Bare hisaab ko hamesha kisi aur tareeqe se check kar lein; imtihan mein ek digit ki ghalti poore number zaya kar deti hai.

blocks.prompt: 10 (c) In how many ways can a set of 4 different blue pens, 3 different red pens and 6 black pens be placed in a rectangular form rack with a space for 10 pens if: Only the red pens are placed together.
blocks.explanation:
Is baar sirf 3 laal pens ikatthe rehne hain; neele aur kaale pens azaad hain.
Humein arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: laal pens ka ek block, baqi 10 pens alag alag units; units ki tarteeb aur block ke andar ki tarteeb multiply.
Farq dekhiye: part (b) mein teeno rang block the; yahan sirf laal pens block hain aur baqi pens khule hain, jo kahin bhi aa sakte hain, laal block ke daayein bhi aur baayein bhi.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 4 neele, 3 laal, 6 kaale pens (sab alag), 13 jagahein; sirf laal pens ek saath.
Humein find karna hai: kitne tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Ek block wala block method.
Kyun: "Only the red pens" ka matlab hai sirf laal pens par shart hai. Neele aur kaale pens ko block banane ki koi zaroorat nahi, warna hum ghalat taur par un par bhi shart laga denge.

Units ginein
\[\text{Khule pens} = 4 + 6 = 10\]
\[\text{Units} = 10 + 1 = 11\]
Kyun: Laal block ek unit ki tarah hilta hai; neele aur kaale pens har ek apni alag unit hain. "Unit" yaani jo cheez ek tukre ki tarah hile.
Dhyan dein: Units ginte waqt block ko 3 nahi, 1 ginna hai; yahin aksar students 13 units likh dete hain.

11 units ki tarteeb
\[11! = 11 \times 10!\]
\[= 11 \times 3628800 = 39916800\]
Kyun: 11 alag units, 11 positions. \(10!\) Sawal 9(a) se liya.

Block ke andar tarteeb aur multiply
\[3! \times 11! = 6 \times 39916800\]
\[= 239500800\]
Kyun: Laal block ke andar 3 laal pens \(3!\) tareeqon se aage peeche ho sakte hain.
Dhyan dein: Block ke andar ka \(3!\) part (b) ki tarah yahan bhi zaroori hai; is ke baghair jawab 6 guna kam aayega.

Tasdeeq
\[3! \times 11! = \dfrac{13!}{26} = \dfrac{6227020800}{26}\]
\[= 239500800 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(\frac{13!}{3! \times 11!} = \frac{13 \times 12}{6} = 26\), is liye \(13!\) ko 26 se divide karne par bhi yahi aana chahiye, aur aaya.
